stem.text: Which statement about the halogens or halide ions is correct?

A.text: Bromide ions react to form a white precipitate when added to silver nitrate solution.

B.text: Bromine does **not** oxidise chloride ions when added to sodium chloride solution.

C.text: Fluorine atoms form cations by accepting electrons when they react.

D.text: Chloride ions are stronger reducing agents than iodide ions.
